name: Creamy White Bean "Alfredo" Soup with Bacon, Mushrooms, Kale & Parsley
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
1 (10 oz) bag kale, cut and ready to use
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
When the bacon is done, add mushrooms to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add beans, broth, Alfredo sauce, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

Once boiling, add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook until beans and kale are tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the soup is done, remove from heat, add parsley, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
